name: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power Co., Ltd. engages in thermal power generation business in China and internationally. The company provides thermal products, as well as invests in nuclear power projects. It also engages in gas power generation, integrated energy and other businesses; coal-fired generation; shipping and port management services; and engineering maintenance, power equipment and engineering, and trading business. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Electric Power Development. Zhejiang Zheneng Electric Power Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
